ns2:group.ns2:description:
Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing says humanoid robots could soon outrun humans.
Speaking at the China Internet Media Forum, Wang said robots from multiple companies may complete a half marathon in under one hour at an upcoming race in Beijing next month.
He added the industry has not yet reached its inflection point, but progress is accelerating rapidly.
Wang predicts a “ChatGPT moment” for embodied AI could arrive within two to three years, when robots can handle most tasks in unfamiliar environments via voice commands. Some industry insiders say it could happen in as little as 18 months.

ns2:group.ns2:title: OpenAI cancels Sora, Disney deal also ends
ns2:group.ns2:description:
OpenAI said it will shut down Sora, its AI video generation tool, and will soon announce a timeline for taking the app and API offline, along with plans for how users can save their videos.
Sora was first introduced in February 2024 as a technical preview. Built on a diffusion-transformer model, it could generate highly detailed video clips up to 60 seconds long.
After more than a year of updates, Sora 2 launched in September 2025 as a standalone social app and quickly reached No.1 on Apple’s App Store free chart, with over one million downloads in five days.
OpenAI also confirmed the end of a partnership with Disney that allowed users to generate videos using licensed characters.
